content.short: WigoSwap is a DeFi platform with a DEX, staking, farming, and a mini-game.
content.description: WigoSwap is a DeFi platform focused on speed, security, and simplicity. It uses WIGO tokens and includes WigoBridge for cross-chain transfers and swaps. The project roadmap includes WigoRun, an IDO platform, and Super-dApp, a gamified multi-chain experience, along with DeTasker to disrupt the freelance market. The protocol features an AMM, yield farming, and an NFT marketplace, plus exclusive NFTs, Wiggy PFPs, and quests to drive engagement and cross-platform collaboration. WigoBridge enables single-transaction cross-chain transfers across supported blockchains, making multi-chain interactions easier.
